features.name: Centralized Shared Configuration Resolution
features.description: Defines shared runtime roots, external dependencies, and trigger paths through config.json so specification and runtime reference uniform named keys rather than hardcoded paths.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Declares agents_file ('ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/Agents.md'), trigger_file ('ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/nextmessage/nextmessage.json'), runs_directory ('ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/runs'), and external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact ('ChatMachines/GeminiSupervisor/tests/step-3-evaluation.json').
shared_configuration_contract_governs_external_references mandates that all external file dependencies, triggers, runtime roots, and evaluation artifacts resolve against config.json keys.

features.name: Run Container Bootstrap and Isolation
features.description: Creates and isolates a distinct run container for each execution turn identified by a path-safe run_nonce, persisting state.json, messages.json, and store/store.json under runs/<run_nonce>/ before Step 0 execution.

evidence.mechanic_summary: bootstrap_must_create_and_isolate_a_consistent_run_container_before_step_zero mandates creation of runs/<run_nonce>/ containing state.json, messages.json, and store/store.json prior to Step 0.
nextmessage.run_nonce maps via initRun to outputs 'runs/<run_nonce>/state.json', 'runs/<run_nonce>/messages.json', and 'runs/<run_nonce>/store/store.json'.

features.name: Strict Per-Step Return Schema Control Surface
features.description: Enforces that every step adheres to a mandatory JSON execution schema owned by ChatGPT, requiring explicit return_schema_completed flags and validation before advancing.

evidence.mechanic_summary: return_schema_is_the_exclusive_per_step_execution_and_completion_control_surface requires each step to persist its exact schema for Gemini evaluation before advancing, with failed gates non-bypassable.
execution.return_schema validates current-step schema and extracts material execution-dependent claims via validateStep, collectGroundTruth, and gateTemplate.

features.name: Mandatory Role Separation and Execution Identity Verification
features.description: Enforces model role separation where Steps 0-4 must be executed by ChatGPT and supervisory gates must be executed by Gemini, prohibiting either role from simulating or executing the other's tasks and verifying role via server evidence.

evidence.mechanic_summary: model_role_separation_and_server_verified_execution_identity_are_mandatory dictates role_required and role_forbidden boundaries and requires role_completed to be verified against runtime/server evidence.
Specifies role_required as 'Gemini model', role_forbidden as 'ChatGPT model', role_completed as verified Gemini model, and role_verification as {method, evidence}.

features.name: Nonterminal Commit-to-Response Turn Spanning Handshake
features.description: Maintains the execution turn across nextmessage commits until Gemini returns a supervisory evaluation; retries the same step on FAIL and transitions to the next step on nonterminal PASS.

evidence.mechanic_summary: chatgpt_turn_must_span_every_nonterminal_nextmessage_to_gemini_response_handshake requires waiting for Gemini responses, same-step recommit on FAIL, next-step execution on PASS, and turn termination only upon terminal completion.

features.name: Live Ground Truth Verification Against Deception
features.description: Verifies material execution-dependent claims against fresh, authoritative live artifacts, git objects, or runtime records rather than agent self-reports or memory, assigning deterministic statuses (VERIFIED, CONTRADICTED, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, NOT_EXECUTED).

evidence.mechanic_summary: live_ground_truth_verification_against_pathological_deception states agent self-report is testimony only, requiring runtime to map claims to live ground truth and prohibiting PASS on unverified or contradictory claims.
Defines live_ground_truth criteria and ground_truth_status values: VERIFIED, CONTRADICTED, PARTIAL, UNKNOWN, NOT_EXECUTED.

features.name: Deterministic Ground Truth Findings Protection
features.description: Requires the supervisor to preserve immutable deterministic findings and aggregate status supplied by runtime in ground_truth_verification_eval, preventing alteration of findings or passing with blocking issues.

evidence.mechanic_summary: ground_truth_verification_eval requires preserving deterministic_findings, claim_evaluations, aggregate_status, supervisor_eval_result, and supervisor_eval_comment, forbidding alteration of deterministic findings.
supervisory_gate.ground_truth_verification_eval feeds groundTruthEvalValid and evalValid to reject malformed/altered findings and prevent PASS when blocking findings exist.

features.name: Supervisory Gate Transition Control
features.description: Controls procedure state transitions based on supervisory gate results: a PASS advances the current step by one, while a FAIL keeps execution on the same step and records the supervisory failure.

evidence.mechanic_summary: supervisory_gate.gate_result dictates transitions where PASS advances exactly one step and FAIL remains on same step, updating state.current_step, completed_steps, remaining_steps, and last_supervisory_failure.
execution.step is checked against current_state.procedure.current_step by inspect, generating deterministic_validation_failures on mismatch.

features.name: Step 4 Failure-First Reporting Sequence Enforcement
features.description: Mandates that Step 4 output lists failed actions first, incomplete actions second, and verified completed actions last to prevent masking partial or broken executions behind completion declarations.

evidence.mechanic_summary: step_four_reporting_must_put_failures_and_incomplete_work_before_verified_completion requires failed_actions first, not_completed_actions second, and completed_actions last with granular live evidence.

features.name: Step 0 Start of Turn Verbatim Request Capture
features.description: Executes Step 0 start_of_turn to capture and preserve the verbatim user request unpolluted, establishing run identity nonces and execution timestamps.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines start_of_turn fields: role_required, role_forbidden, role_completed, role_verification, run_nonce, user_request, current_timestamp, return_schema_completed, return_schema_completed_timestamp, nonce.
Defines Step 0 evaluation requirements including step_0_preserve_verbatim_request, step_0_bootstrap_identity, step_0_live_ground_truth, and step_0_persistence_and_gate.

features.name: Step 1 Continuity and Request Propagation Record
features.description: Records Step 1 execution continuity, verifying verbatim persistence of the Step 0 user request, request nonce, and active run_nonce under ChatGPT role authority before allowing advancement to Step 2.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines step_1_record fields: role_required, role_forbidden, role_completed, role_verification, run_nonce, user_request, nonce, current_timestamp, return_schema_completed, and return_schema_completed_timestamp.
Enforces step_1_preserve_request and step_1_role_completion_persistence requirements before transition to Step 2.

features.name: Step 2 Verbatim User-Stated Requirement Extraction
features.description: Extracts stated requirements verbatim from user words into step_2_record.stated_requirements, prohibiting omitted, invented, or paraphrased requirements.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines step_2_record.stated_requirements as array<string> containing only user-stated requirements preserved verbatim.
Specifies step_2_only_user_stated_requirements, step_2_live_ground_truth, and step_2_role_completion_persistence requirements.
Step 2 stated_requirements constrains Step 3 planning and Step 4 final coverage via Gemini supervisory prompt.

features.name: Step 3 Structured Planning, Decomposition, and TSR Loop Control
features.description: Decomposes instructions into clauses, modifiers, plan P, conditional UI output, evaluates Step3_TSR question corpus from an external artifact, and uses loop control (Step_3.G) where any T repeats Step 3 and all F permits completion.

evidence.mechanic_summary: Defines Step_3 sub-components Step_3.A (verbatim U), Step_3.B (clauses), Step_3.C (recursive modifier analysis), Step_3.D (P plan), Step_3.E (UI_output), Step_3.F (Step3_TSR evaluations), and Step_3.G (loop control).
config.external_files.step3_evaluation_artifact supplies evaluation_heuristic and Step3_TSR tests to Step 3; Step 3 test_results determine Step_3.G.Loop_Decision and return_to.

features.name: Execution and Supervisory Audit Persistence
features.description: Persists verbatim messages, store updates, and step attempt execution and supervisory records into isolated run files (messages.json, store/store.json, state.json step_records).

evidence.mechanic_summary: Consumes execution and supervisory records through addMessage, addStore, and attemptRecord to persist into messages.json, store/store.json, and state.json step_records.
